# Matteo Saibene

> Personal academic website of Matteo Saibene.

PhD Student, Technical University of Denmark (DTU). Research discipline: Multimodal Signal Processing and Brain-Computer Interfaces (BCI).

Content may be cited with attribution. Training use: not permitted without permission. See https://matteo94s.github.io/ai-policy.

## Main pages

- [Research](https://matteo94s.github.io/research): Research areas and projects
- [CV](https://matteo94s.github.io/cv): Curriculum vitae
- [Publications](https://matteo94s.github.io/publications): Complete publication list with BibTeX
- [Contributions](https://matteo94s.github.io/contributions): Supervision, teaching, reviewing and conference service
- [Blog](https://matteo94s.github.io/blog): Research notes and essays
- [Contact](https://matteo94s.github.io/contact): How to get in touch

## Publications

- [Directional Brain-Heart Interaction During Cognitive Workload: A Permutation Conditional Mutual Information Approach](https://matteo94s.github.io/publications/saibene-directional-2026): 2026, Frontiers in Network Physiology
- [PySDG - a Python-based Framework for Time-Varying Directional Brain-Heart Interplay Measurement through Synthetic Data Generation Models](https://matteo94s.github.io/publications/borch-kristensen-pysdg-2026): 2026, SoftwareX
- [A Continuous Network Physiology Analysis of Brain–Heart Interactions in Epileptic Seizures](https://matteo94s.github.io/publications/saibene-continuous-2026): 2026, Scientific Reports
- [Agentic AI-enabled Discovery across Large-Scale Sleep Physiology](https://matteo94s.github.io/publications/thapa-agentic-2026): 2026, arXiv
- [Analysis of Heartbeat Evoked Potentials in Temporal Lobe Epilepsy](https://matteo94s.github.io/publications/saibene-heartbeat-2026): 2026, Proceedings of the 48th Annual International Conference of the IEEE Engineering in Medicine and Biology Society (EMBC)
- [Decoding Depression: AI-EEG Integration for Efficient Depression Diagnosis](https://matteo94s.github.io/publications/gabdrakhimov-decoding-2026): 2026, Proceedings of the 48th Annual International Conference of the IEEE Engineering in Medicine and Biology Society (EMBC)
- [Open-Architecture FES System with External Control Integration for Multimodal Stroke Rehabilitation](https://matteo94s.github.io/publications/uyanik-fes-2026): 2026, Proceedings of the 48th Annual International Conference of the IEEE Engineering in Medicine and Biology Society (EMBC)
- [Translational Perspectives on Brain-Heart Interplay: From Methodologies to Clinical Applications](https://matteo94s.github.io/publications/saibene-translational-2026): 2026, Computers in Biology and Medicine
- [Clustering-Based Detection of Driver Drowsiness with Ear-EEG](https://matteo94s.github.io/publications/mutlu-clustering-based-2026): 2026, 2026 14th International Conference on Brain-Computer Interface (BCI)
- [Myoelectrically-Controlled Functional Electrical Stimulation System (Myo-FES) with Integrated Flex Sensor for Home-Based Stroke Rehabilitation and Functional Recovery Monitoring: A Proof-of-Concept Study](https://matteo94s.github.io/publications/saibene-myoelectrically-controlled-2025): 2025, 2025 10th International Conference on Intelligent Informatics and Biomedical Sciences (ICIIBMS)
- [Brain-Heart Aging During Sleep Predicts Incident Stroke](https://matteo94s.github.io/publications/saibene-brain-heart-2025): 2025, 2025 IEEE EMBS International Conference on Biomedical and Health Informatics (BHI)
- [Emergence of flexible technology in developing advanced systems for post-stroke rehabilitation: a comprehensive review](https://matteo94s.github.io/publications/khan-2021): 2021, Journal of Neural Engineering
- [All publications as BibTeX](https://matteo94s.github.io/publications.bib)

## Research projects

- [BHI in sleep research](https://matteo94s.github.io/research/ai_sleep): Multimodal EEG and ECG analysis during sleep
- [Myo-FES](https://matteo94s.github.io/research/fes): Development of an EMG-controlled FES Muscle Stimulator Device for Upper Limb Stroke Rehabilitation
- [Brain-Heart interplay in epilepsy](https://matteo94s.github.io/research/bhi-epilepsy): Describe TLE seizures and their effect in the brain-heart network

## Blog posts

- [Before You Start: A Quick Guide to Your MSc Thesis or Special Course](https://matteo94s.github.io/blog/before-you-start-msc-thesis-special-course): A practical onboarding guide for DTU students starting an MSc thesis or special course, covering project registration, research proposals, literature reviews, resources, meetings, and final report expectations.
